Comment.value: Weapon Master initiation reagent (roadmap: weapon-master-quest). Cut from the Guard's practice post below the walls of Minas Tirith (q_wpm_dummy OnUsed, instance tag WMTrialPost) only when the striking PC's main-hand weapon is one whose Weapon of Choice feat they have (QWPM_IsSwornBlade in q_wpm_inc -- baseitems.2da WeaponOfChoiceFeat via Get2DAString + GetHasFeat). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_wpm_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_wpm_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 24 + ModelPart1 44 copied from the module's existing Ember of the Old Wyrm (q_rdd_ember).

value.0: A chip of seasoned oak no longer than a finger, freed from the Guard's practice post below the white walls of Minas Tirith by a single clean stroke. The grain carries a century of other masters' cuts, thin as script, and now one more. The training row keeps no ledger and issues no papers: the notch is the proof, and it means nothing to anyone but the hand that cut it -- and Halmir the Grey, who reads wood grain the way other men read letters.
